description: This file defines the 'GlobalServices' class, which models the XML <global-services> element in the OFBiz framework configuration. It reads attributes 'loader' and 'location' from an XML Element and provides accessor methods.

classes.name: GlobalServices
classes.description: Immutable class representing the <global-services> configuration element with loader and location attributes.

methods.name: GlobalServices
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GlobalServices object by extracting 'loader' and 'location' attributes from the provided XML Element, throwing ServiceConfigException if attributes are missing or empty.
